annotations.title: NFL Prop Market Board (Kalshi vs the books vs exchanges)

description: Use for "where is the best price on <player> receiving yards" and "is Kalshi cheaper than the books". Best price on every NFL prop this week: Kalshi (fee included) vs five books (DraftKings, FanDuel, BetRivers, Fanatics, ESPN) and the Novig and ProphetX exchanges — the best price per side, how much cheaper Kalshi is than the books, the consensus gap, and the Kalshi close once a strike settles. Filter by team, game, player or stat.

game.description: Game anchor away-home, e.g. "ne-sea" — rows for that game only.

gapsOnly.description: Only strikes where Kalshi and the consensus are 5¢+ apart (default false).

limit.description: Max rows (default 15). Values above 50 are clamped to 50.

statType.description: Optional prop type filter. One of: pass_yds · pass_tds · rush_yds · rec_yds · receptions · anytime_td.

team.description: Team abbrev (SEA, NE, LAR, JAX) — rows for that club only.

name: nfl_prop_board

rows.description: Priced Kalshi prop strikes: player, stat, strike, Kalshi book, consensus, venue quotes, gap, best price per side.

summary.description: Board counts: listed, booked, consensus-priced, gaps, arbs, games.

tell_user.description: Show this sentence to the user first.
